content:
# PROMPT 01A
# CANONICAL REFERENCE ATLAS GENERATION

Version: 1.0

Status: Mandatory

Priority: CRITICAL

---

# PURPOSE

Generate the canonical visual reference package for the main character.

This prompt must execute before:

- carry production
- sword production
- attack production
- portrait review
- character redesign discussions

Nothing involving character art may start before this step.

---

# SOURCE OF TRUTH

The source atlas MUST be discovered automatically.

Do not assume filenames.

Do not assume hashes.

The implementation must:

1. Locate the atlas referenced by OFFICIAL_FRAMES.
2. Compute SHA-256.
3. Store the result in:

docs/character-reference-atlas/discovered-source.json

The discovered atlas becomes the canonical source for the remainder of the pipeline.

If multiple candidates exist:

STOP.

Report all candidates.

Require manual approval.

Do not continue.

Metadata:

OFFICIAL_FRAMES

No other source is valid.

Not:

- temporary artwork
- generated artwork
- attack mockups
- carry mockups
- sword mockups
- portraits
- concepts

Only the official atlas.

---

# PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

Create immutable visual documentation.

Future sprites must be compared against this documentation.

This stage does NOT create gameplay assets.

This stage does NOT modify the game.

This stage only establishes visual truth.

---

# DELIVERABLES

Create the directory:

docs/character-reference-atlas/

---

# REQUIRED SHEETS

Generate:

01-idle-sheet.png

Containing every idle frame.

---

Generate:

02-run-sheet.png

Containing every run frame.

---

Generate:

03-jump-sheet.png

Containing every jump frame.

---

Generate:

04-fall-sheet.png

Containing every fall frame.

---

Generate:

05-collect-sheet.png

Containing every collect frame.

---

Generate:

06-all-frames-sheet.png

Containing every frame present in OFFICIAL_FRAMES.

---

Generate:

07-reference-comparison.png

Displaying side by side:

- idle
- run
- jump
- fall
- collect

---

# SCALE REQUIREMENTS

For every sheet generate:

100%

200%

400%

---

Mandatory scaling method:

nearest-neighbor

---

Forbidden:

- bilinear filtering
- bicubic filtering
- blur
- anti-aliasing
- smoothing

The objective is to reveal original pixels.

---

# CHARACTER DOCUMENTATION

Generate:

character-identity.md

---

Document:

## Head

Visual proportions.

Shape.

Approximate silhouette.

---

## Hair

Volume.

Silhouette.

Shape.

Ponytail structure.

---

## Face

Eye placement.

Mouth placement.

Visual complexity.

---

## Dress

Shape.

Width.

Rendering style.

---

## Shoes

Shape.

Scale.

Placement.

---

## Body

General silhouette.

Body proportions.

---

## Rendering

Palette.

Shadows.

Outline.

Texture.

---

# CANONICAL JSON

Generate:

canonical-reference.json

Must include:

- source hash
- frame names
- width
- height
- anchorX
- anchorY
- source coordinates

---

# STATE AUDIT

Generate:

reference-audit.md

---

Answer:

How many idle frames exist?

How many run frames exist?

How many jump frames exist?

How many fall frames exist?

How many collect frames exist?

---

Answer:

Does the atlas provide:

walk_up?

walk_down?

carry?

sword?

attack?

---

Expected result:

walk_up = NO

walk_down = NO

carry = NO

sword = NO

attack = NO

---

# FEW SHOT 01

CORRECT

Official run frame.

↓

Future carry frame.

↓

Same rendering.

↓

Same face.

↓

Same hair.

↓

Same dress.

↓

Only pose changed.

APPROVE.

---

# FEW SHOT 02

INCORRECT

Official run frame.

↓

Generated artwork.

↓

More detail.

↓

Different face.

↓

Different eyes.

REJECT.

---

# FEW SHOT 03

INCORRECT

Official run frame.

↓

Different shading.

↓

Different contrast.

↓

Different saturation.

REJECT.

---

# FEW SHOT 04

CORRECT

Official run frame.

↓

Future sword frame.

↓

Same identity.

↓

Same artwork.

↓

Additional object only.

APPROVE.

---

# SCRIPT

Create:

scripts/build-reference-atlas.js

---

Responsibilities:

Read OFFICIAL_FRAMES.

Extract every frame.

Generate documentation sheets automatically.

Generate metadata automatically.

Generate audit automatically.

---

# VALIDATION

Execute:

node scripts/build-reference-atlas.js

---

Verify:

All sheets generated.

All states documented.

All metadata generated.

---

# FAILURE CONDITIONS

Immediate failure if:

- atlas hash differs
- frames cannot be extracted
- coordinates invalid
- sheets incomplete
- metadata incomplete

---

# APPROVAL

This prompt is approved when:

- every official frame is documented
- every official state is documented
- atlas becomes frozen reference

---

# BLOCKING RULE

No carry.

No sword.

No attack.

No portrait review.

No integration.

Until this prompt is formally approved.

---

# END GOAL

Any future reviewer must be able to answer:

"What does the character actually look like?"

using only this documentation.

No future artwork may redefine the answer.
`
